scope: Measure and sweep allocation failures across the GROUP handle planner, verifying rollback and same-codec retry state.

behavior: The focused test configures a source GROUP handle and explicit output remap, measures all allocations on a successful plan, then injects std::bad_alloc at every measured offset in planDxfGroupHandles.
Each injected failure returns without freezing or retaining a partial planned GROUP handle vector.
After every failure, resetting the same codec write session permits a successful plan bound to the expected remapped output handle.
The control runs with both ASCII and Binary writer configurations and creates no DWG/DXF fixtures.

limitations: This isolates the GROUP handle planner allocation path; it does not inject allocation failures into later IMAGEDEF, dictionary, or other OBJECTS assembly builders.
The control is internal writer safety evidence only and does not qualify DXF consumer semantics or promote support claims.
next: Inject failures into the remaining OBJECTS staging builders and keep cross-family rollback, source lifetime, platform policy, and scoped concurrency open.
